reason: I'm not letting an AI answer my customers on its own when I've spent twenty years building those relationships. And 99 euros a month for something I'd have to babysit, on top of a CRM nobody even updates, isn't going to survive my monthly subscription review.
objection: One wrong or tone-deaf reply from the AI to a good client and I lose more than a year of subscription fees. I don't know what 100 credits actually buys me either, so I can't tell what the real monthly cost will be.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run in a business like mine with every customer-facing message held for my approval first, plus a clear explanation of what a credit covers, during a free month I can cancel without hassle.
